articles.author: Daniel Wu
articles.title: Americans are drinking less since the pandemic began, but one group bucks the trend - The Washington Post
articles.description: Studies previously found alcohol consumption and deaths surged during the pandemic as Americans grappled with stress and isolation.
articles.content:
Americans are drinking less for the first time since the coronavirus pandemic began, but drinking levels are still higher than before the pandemic, according to a new study published this week.
